title: SandboxPartnerPurgedPayload
description: Payload of `sandbox.partner.purged` version 1. A Partner's sandbox untouched for 90 days was purged: its twin and everything placed in it are gone, and its next sandbox key makes it again. Consumers: analytics. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

twin_partner_id.description: The twin, the Partner the sandbox keys act on.

touched_at.description: When a sandbox key last acted on it.
